"""Probe: does gitleaks stdin's StartLine count lines of the whole stdin across fragments? Prints counts only."""
import json
import os
import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, "/home/usain/gov-os-worktrees/W2-88/src")
from gov import secrets  # noqa: E402

tmp = Path(sys.argv[1])
tmp.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
(tmp / ".gitleaks.toml").write_text(Path("/home/usain/gov-os-worktrees/W2-88/template/.gitleaks.toml").read_text())
rules = secrets._rules(tmp)
secret = "".join(("proj", "_CAN", "ARY_", "abc123"))
texts = []
planted = {}
for i in range(300):
    body = "\n".join(f"line {j} of file {i}" for j in range(5 + i % 40))
    if i in (3, 150, 299):
        body += "\nthe value " + secret + "\nmore\n"
        planted[i] = True
    texts.append(body.encode())
parts, spans, line = [b"\n"], [], 2
for n, t in enumerate(texts):
    for piece in secrets._pieces(t):
        block = piece + b"\n\n"
        parts.append(block)
        spans.append((line, line + block.count(b"\n") - 1, n))
        line += block.count(b"\n")
data = b"".join(parts)
env = {k: v for k, v in os.environ.items() if k != "GITLEAKS_CONFIG"}
for each in rules:
    done = subprocess.run(["gitleaks", "stdin", "--no-banner", "--report-format", "json", "--report-path", "-",
                           "--ignore-gitleaks-allow", "--gitleaks-ignore-path", "/dev/null", "--log-level", "error",
                           "--exit-code", "3"], input=data, capture_output=True, env=env | {"GITLEAKS_CONFIG_TOML": each})
    print("exit", done.returncode)
    for f in json.loads(done.stdout or "[]"):
        at = f["StartLine"]
        owner = next((n for a, b, n in spans if a <= at <= b), None)
        print("finding rule", f["RuleID"], "start", at, "owner", owner, "expected in", sorted(planted))
